title: Clínica Veterinária de Cascais (brand edition)
subtitle: Vet clinic one-pager on the real identity
description: Bold, logo-driven one-pager for a Cascais vet clinic. The emblem's cyan sky, magenta ground and triple ring shape the whole layout, with a dog/cat split, pet-age calculators and a four-step booking wizard with live time slots.
conceptNote: Unofficial concept for a real business, using its existing logo. Not affiliated.
